faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Vancouver at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: What should a Vancouver page include?
faqs.a: A clear description of your treatment, the areas you cover, how to book a consultation, what it costs, and the proof patients look for before they make contact.

faqs.q: Do neighbourhood pages actually help in Vancouver?
faqs.a: Yes. Patients in Vancouver often search with a neighbourhood or district attached, from Coal Harbour to Kerrisdale, so distinct pages for the areas you serve help you appear for those more specific searches.

faqs.q: Is Vancouver too competitive to bother with SEO?
faqs.a: Not if you are specific. Vancouver is large enough that most of its searches are narrow, and those narrow searches are the ones a focused orthodontist can realistically own.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee the number one position?
